nome_jp: 森仙のJ ロマネスク
testo:
■ Sympathy: Your Creatures (This creature costs 1 less to summon for each of your creatures. It can't cost less than 1.)
Mach Fighter
Triple Breaker
■ When you put this creature, put the top 4 cards of your deck into your mana zone. Then you may return a card from your mana zone to your hand.
■ Each of your creatures gets "shield saver".
